scope: Selected final checkpoint of the older comparison architecture versus the earlier supervised-adapted six-target NSF. This does not fulfill the corrected full-Gaia architecture. Common predictions and native labels retain distinct conventions; benchmark/cluster ancestry, teacher dependencies and shared Gaia inputs remain. DEV is not a pristine final test.

population_panel_selection.scope: Uniform model-blind panels, excluding extra benchmark/cluster/seismic/TESS QA augmentation

benchmark_counts.scope: Fundamental Teff uses flux/diameter; logg uses parallax and evolutionary masses; Fe I and Fe II references stay separate. Parent/survey calibration ancestry is not certified independent.

benchmark_scope: Common predictions compared separately with Fe I and Fe II. Native/source maps used only for catalogue compatibility. Lower cluster dispersion alone does not prove calibrated accuracy.
